title: The garage door, shut
logline: The garage from the alley in May: the door shut, the window dark by day, the dog's bowl outside, full. Someone fills it. The page doesn't show who.

panels.composition: A plain garage door shut beside a tavern's back wall in May light, its small window dark, a dog's bowl outside the door, full of water.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a plain shut garage door beside a tavern's back wall in May light with a dark window and a dog's bowl full of water outside it, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
